paragraphs.text: I started my journey in development in
, when I got certified in Full Stack Web Development by ProgramadorBr. I haven't stopped since. Every project was a chance to deepen what I knew and discover what I still had to learn.

, where I got to lead the development of web and mobile interfaces. That's where I learned to think about components for real — not just code that works today, but that someone else can understand, use and maintain tomorrow. SSR, accessibility, a Design System documented in Storybook: I learned frontend goes way beyond what shows up on screen.
, I kept evolving web and mobile products, reinforcing the internal Design System and deepening my experience with GraphQL and API integration in close collaboration with the backend team.

, allocated to Livelo as part of the Design System team (Alchemy). Building and maintaining the components and tokens other teams use daily is work that demands precision, empathy for the dev consuming it, and long-term vision. It's the kind of challenge that drives me.
at Unicarioca to solidify the theoretical base behind what I've already practiced for years.
Outside work, I like exploring personal projects —
is my own design system, where I experiment with ideas and consolidate patterns I use across my projects. I believe the best way to grow as a developer is by building real things, with purpose.

heap.title: Mid-level Front-End Developer
heap.description: Led the development of web and mobile interfaces with React, Next.js, and React Native while prioritising performance and accessibility. Structured data flows with RESTful APIs, introduced SSR to boost SEO metrics, and standardised components via Design Systems documented in Storybook. Partnered with design on UX/UI principles and enabled continuous delivery with agile teams.

divam.title: Mid-level Front-End Developer
divam.description: Worked on evolving web products with Next.js and mobile apps with React Native, delivering new features while keeping production stable. Enhanced the internal Design System with reusable components and design tokens for colour, spacing, and typography, reinforcing accessibility and responsiveness standards. Collaborated with backend on APIs, led code reviews, and aligned data flows across projects.

ilia.title: Frontend Developer | Design System @ Livelo
ilia.description: Frontend developer embedded at Livelo through ília's team. Part of the Design System team (Alchemy), where we build and maintain the components and tokens used by other teams in both React and React Native. Beyond development, we support cross-functional teams and build collaborative components on demand.
